note: Human labels from the shooter stepping through review videos (2026-09-14). Frames are indices in the named review video; release happens between frame N and N+1. Review windows start at the listed file time; file time = start + (N + 0.5) / 30; real time = file time / 4.
conclusion: pose-based release (ball ≥ 1 diameter from the nearer wrist, above it, rising) has a mean bias of −1.8 file frames = −15 ms real (≈ 0.8° of release angle at 7 m/s); ball-only release fails when the tracker follows the held ball.
